name: ONLY FARMS 🍑
source:
ONLY FARMS is an adult visual novel set in a rival-filled countryside. Reclaim your name through choices, festival challenges, and tangled relationships. Explore secrets, chase unfinished desires, and prove who truly owns the land this summer. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4657600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《唯独农场》（ONLY FARMS）是一部设定在竞争激烈的乡村田园的成人视觉小说。通过关键抉择、庆典挑战与错综复杂的情感纠葛重振你的声名，探索隐秘真相、追逐未竟的欲望，在这个夏天证明究竟谁才是这片土地真正的主人。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4657600/]Steam[/url]]
